title: Pan-Seared German Seitan Skillet
description: A hearty German-inspired dish made with pan-seared seitan, onions, and bell peppers, finished with a rich wine sauce.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of oil to the skillet and sear the seitan until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil to the skillet and sauté the onion and bell pepper until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the red wine to the skillet and bring to a simmer, scraping up any browned bits.
Add the vegetable broth, tomato paste, flour, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Stir to combine.
Return the seitan to the skillet and simmer, covered, until the sauce has thickened and the seitan is coated, about 10-12 minutes.
Serve the seitan and sauce hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
